description: This file contains function prototypes, macros, constants, and type definitions for the ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter) peripheral of the STM32F10x microcontroller series. It defines structures for ADC configuration, constants for trigger sources, data alignment, channels, and interrupt flags, as well as function prototypes for initializing and controlling ADC operations.

methods.name: ADC_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes the specified ADC peripheral registers to their default reset values.

methods.name: ADC_Init
methods.description: Initializes the ADC peripheral according to the specified parameters in the ADC_InitTypeDef structure.

methods.name: ADC_StructInit
methods.description: Fills each ADC_InitTypeDef member with its default value.

methods.name: ADC_Cmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified ADC peripheral.

methods.name: ADC_DMACmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the ADC DMA interface.

methods.name: ADC_ITConfig
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified ADC interrupts.

methods.name: ADC_ResetCalibration
methods.description: Resets the calibration registers of the specified ADC.

methods.name: ADC_GetResetCalibrationStatus
methods.description: Returns the calibration reset status.

methods.name: ADC_StartCalibration
methods.description: Starts the calibration of the specified ADC.

methods.name: ADC_GetCalibrationStatus
methods.description: Returns the calibration status.

methods.name: ADC_SoftwareStartConvCmd
methods.description: Starts the ADC conversion using software.

methods.name: ADC_GetConversionValue
methods.description: Returns the most recent ADC conversion value.

methods.name: ADC_GetDualModeConversionValue
methods.description: Returns the dual mode conversion value.

methods.name: ADC_AutoInjectedConvCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the auto-injected group conversion.

methods.name: ADC_InjectedDiscModeCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the injected group discontinuous mode.

methods.name: ADC_ExternalTrigConvCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the external trigger for regular channels.

methods.name: ADC_ExternalTrigInjectedConvConfig
methods.description: Configures the external trigger source for injected channels.

methods.name: ADC_ExternalTrigInjectedConvCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the external trigger for injected channels.

methods.name: ADC_SoftwareStartInjectedConvCmd
methods.description: Starts the injected group conversion using software.

methods.name: ADC_InjectedChannelConfig
methods.description: Configures a specific injected channel.

methods.name: ADC_InjectedSequencerLengthConfig
methods.description: Configures the length of the injected sequence.

methods.name: ADC_SetInjectedOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for an injected channel.

methods.name: ADC_GetInjectedConversionValue
methods.description: Returns the conversion value for an injected channel.

methods.name: ADC_AnalogWatchdogCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the analog watchdog.

methods.name: ADC_AnalogWatchdogThresholdsConfig
methods.description: Configures the high and low thresholds for the analog watchdog.

methods.name: ADC_AnalogWatchdogSingleChannelConfig
methods.description: Configures a single channel for the analog watchdog.

methods.name: ADC_TempSensorVrefintCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the temperature sensor and Vrefint.

methods.name: ADC_GetFlagStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of specified ADC flags.

methods.name: ADC_ClearFlag
methods.description: Clears the specified ADC flags.

methods.name: ADC_GetITStatus
methods.description: Checks whether the specified ADC interrupt has occurred.

methods.name: ADC_ClearITPendingBit
methods.description: Clears the ADC interrupt pending bits.
